reforms.description: The Department of Health and Human Services has established a Patient Safety Task Force to identify and implement improvement strategies in healthcare quality.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Improving healthcare quality can lead to better health outcomes and increased efficiency in the healthcare system.
reforms.status_evidence: The task force has been established and is operational.
reforms.importance_rationale: The establishment of a task force represents a significant but narrower reform aimed at improving healthcare quality.
reforms.source_quote: The Department of Health and Human Services has established a Patient Safety Task Force to identify and implement improvement strategies.

reforms.description: The Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 introduced significant reforms to enhance the accuracy of corporate financial statements and established a new oversight body for accountants, aiming to restore investor confidence.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhancing the accuracy of financial statements can improve market confidence and stability, fostering a better investment environment.
reforms.status_evidence: The act has been enacted and is currently in force.
reforms.importance_rationale: The Sarbanes-Oxley Act represents a major overhaul of corporate governance and financial reporting standards.
reforms.source_quote: The Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 created a new oversight body to supervise accountants, tightened the responsibility of corporate officers for financial reports and stiffened penalties.
